detail.title: Preference Emergence
detail.question: Can stable preferences emerge from path-dependent memory and interaction?
detail.reason: Aligns with the mission to understand if experience shapes internal drives without explicit programming.

detail.title: Path Dependence in Preference Formation
detail.question: Do reinforcement-learning-based preference formation systems exhibit path dependence and longitudinal stability, or are preferences volatile based on initial conditions?
detail.reason: Exploring how intelligent processes develop persistent preferences from accumulation of experience.

detail.title: Path-Dependent Preference Formation
detail.question: Can accumulated experience produce stable, observable preferences in an intelligent process without those preferences being explicitly programmed?
detail.reason: Establishing a formal project to investigate the emergence of preferences through path-dependent memory.
